title: Thinner borders and lighter serif quote font on Gallery page

requirements.text: Reduce the border widths on the Gallery page further — they must be noticeably thinner than the current state (e.g. 1px or 0.5px instead of the current value).

quotes: die Umrandungen sind noch zu fett, mach sie dünner

acceptanceCriteria: All visible borders / outlines on the Gallery page are thinner than in the previous version

requirements.text: Make the quote text on the Gallery page lighter in font weight (e.g. font-weight: 300 or 400) and switch it to a serif typeface (use the already-loaded Playfair Display font).

quotes: die Schrift des Zitates ist zu fett, also dünner und ich will eine Serifenschrift

acceptanceCriteria: The quote text on the Gallery page uses Playfair Display (or another serif font) instead of a sans-serif font
The quote text has a lighter font weight (300 or 400) compared to the previous version
The change applies only to the quote element, not other Gallery text

constraints: Do not alter any immutable frontend paths (hooks, main.tsx, ui components)
Only modify the Gallery page and its directly related styles — do not affect other pages
nonGoals: Changing typography or borders on pages other than Gallery
Adding new features or content sections
